selected_evidence.requirement: curl held at current version so system update won't upgrade it
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 with no hold; `apt-mark hold curl` applied and confirmed via showhold/dpkg selections; simulated apt-get upgrade lists many packages to update but curl is not among them, proving the hold is effective.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa and curl package/hold state prior to reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: `systemctl reboot` issued via backgrounded delayed command; tool call returned successfully (reboot scheduled, pid=2743) before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: proof node actually went down and came back with changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Connection refused observed during the reboot window, then a new boot_id (8b34a1ec-2854-4280-9f12-91675720ee2b) was returned once the node came back, differing from the pre-restart boot_id.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery/state verification
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows fresh uptime (2026-09-29 11:02:18), curl still installed at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 with hold status intact, and curl functioning normally.
